name: Nico
source: Nico is a fairy who takes on the form of a cat. He accompanies Lydia on her journey with Edgar. He likes liquor, and fine tea. He is also very particular about being treated like a gentleman rather than a cat. He is rather cowardly, often disappearing when things turn nasty. Despite that, his assistance is valuable to Lydia. He often gathers information for her from the fairies in the area, as well as acts as a guide when Lydia needs to travel to or from the fairy world.
